about: Budgets of the fast mode of spinal_bisect.ts (spinal_bisect_check.ts in test.sh, core issue 450): variants of the Spinal Tap page on the native engine with no window, 40 ticks of 16 ms. Paths are into the run's JSON (variants.NAME.engine...). Rules of spinal_budgets.mjs: a budget fails when missed; a known failure is printed while it fails and fails the check when met (move it to the budgets); the file may only tighten (ratchet against the merge base). Times have about three times the measurement as margin; frame counters are exact.

native.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1, release engine cc73af028 (timing lock held), before PR 460; spinal_bisect_check.ts 40 ticks

variants.static.engine.tick.layouts.what: the page's DOM with no scripts: 40 ticks lay out nothing (a page that does not change pays no layout)

variants.static.engine.second_layouts.what: a second frame of the unchanged page keeps its layout

variants.empty.engine.tick.median.what: a tick of an empty page

variants.static.engine.first_ms.what: first layered frame of the page's DOM (layout and compile)

variants.static.engine.tick.median.what: a tick of the unchanged page (no layout, no recompile): the cost of an answer that changed nothing

variants.static.engine.probe_ms.what: a whole-page frame with the CPU probe; known slow (issue 450), may not get worse

variants.no-svg.engine.probe_ms.what: the same with no inline SVG: the probe cost is the SVG text (glyph outlines)

variants.static.engine.tick.median.issue: issue 450: an unchanged frame still costs 11 ms (7.6 ms of it the host's finite check, PR 460; the rest is the 4.4 MB answer made again)

variants.static.engine.probe_ms.issue: issue 450: the CPU probe of stroked glyph outlines costs 7 times the frame

window.measured: 2026-11-15, Apple M1, release engine cc73af028, off-screen window, idle_loop_check.ts (4 s after the first frame of an empty page)

window.empty.idle.turnsPerSecond.what: loop wakeups per second of an idle window over 4 s (the first 200 ms of quiet still poll): it waits in the window library up to 100 ms; 10.8 over 14 s; 92 with the old 8 ms poll

window.empty.idle.waits.what: the idle loop waits in the window library (a window library with no wait fails this)

window.empty.idle.eventsAfterWait.what: no native event comes to an idle off-screen window, so every wait ran to its deadline
